note: Expected values copied by hand from the wiki sentences quoted in `evidence`, with the page and revision they were read from. Several come from a page other than the one data/dehydrator.json takes the value from first (e.g. recipe price: Pierre's General Store / Fish Shop; Artisan 40%: Farming/Skill; worked fruit prices: Fruits).

input_count.evidence: Dehydrator requires five Mushrooms (except Red Mushroom) or Fruits of the same type and quality.

unlock.evidence: Dehydrator (Recipe) 10,000g; Dehydrator page: It can be crafted after purchasing the recipe from Pierre for 10,000g.

ingredients.evidence: Dehydrator: Wood 30, Clay 2, Fire Quartz 1; recipe from Pierre's for 10,000g

prize_machine_ticket.evidence: Prize Ticket table row 12: Fish Smoker / Dehydrator, reward chosen at random.

output_quality.evidence: The quality of the dried product is always normal and not affected by the quality of items used.

excluded.evidence: 5 of Any Mushroom (except Red Mushroom); 5 of Any Fruit (except Grapes); Truffles are not classified as mushrooms and therefore cannot be placed into the Dehydrator.

dried-mushrooms.evidence: The sell price of Dried Mushrooms depends on the mushrooms used: ((7.5 x mushroom Base Price) + 25) total ... When the player has the Artisan profession, the sell price changes to ((10.5 x mushroom Base Price) + 35) total

dried-fruit.evidence: Since the Dehydrator requires 5 fruit per use, the sell price of Dried Fruit is (1.5 x Fruit Base Price + 5) per fruit used. With the Artisan Profession, the sell price is (2.1 x Fruit Base Price + 7) per fruit used.

raisins.evidence: Raisins sell for 600 (infobox sellprice = 600); Fruits table Grape row: Raisins 600g, 840g with Artisan; Raisins are made from placing five Grapes inside a Dehydrator.

fruit_prices.evidence: Rendered Fruits table, Dried Fruit / Raisins column (normal quality) and its Artisan (+40%) column

artisan_multiplier.evidence: Artisan goods (wine, cheese, oil, etc.) worth 40% more.

input.evidence: used to create smoked fish using any fish and 1 coal.

minutes.evidence: made from the Fish Smoker using any fish and 1 coal, taking 50 minutes.

price_multiplier.evidence: It doubles the sell price of a fish while retaining quality

artisan_multiplier.evidence: If the player has the Artisan profession, the Smoked Fish will always sell for 2.8 times as much as the original fish.

energy_health_multiplier.evidence: multiplying the energy and health restoration by 1.5

ingredients.evidence: Fish Smoker: Hardwood 10, Sea Jelly 1, River Jelly 1, Cave Jelly 1

riverland_start.evidence: Players start with a Fish Smoker.
